BiblicalUsage: Badal in this form is a part — a portion, a piece. Amos says a shepherd takes out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, and so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria. A scrap saved from the lion's mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the piece of an ear is God's mercy in a hard verse: even when the lion has the flock, he saves a remnant, and I am part of it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
